For simplicity, we'll assign clusters based on image index\n    # In practice, you would cluster the actual CLIP embeddings\n    image_files = sorted(list(image_dir.glob(\"*.jpg\")) + list(image_dir.glob(\"*.png\")))\n    \n    clusters = {}\n    images_per_cluster = len(image_files) // n_clusters\n    remainder = len(image_files) % n_clusters\n    \n    idx = 0\n    for cluster_id in range(n_clusters):\n        cluster_size = images_per_cluster + (1 if cluster_id < remainder else 0)\n        for _ in range(cluster_size):\n            if idx < len(image_files):\n                clusters[image_files[idx].name] = cluster_id\n                idx += 1\n    \n    return clusters\n\n\ndef generate_regime_dataset(\n    regime_name: str,\n    request_sequence: np.ndarray,\n    item_to_image: Dict[int, str],\n    image_embeddings: Dict[str, np.ndarray],\n    image_to_cluster: Dict[str, int],\n    item_popularity: Dict[int, int],\n    n_items: int,\n    timestamp_offset: int = 0\n) -> List[Dict]:\n    \"\"\"Generate a dataset regime with the specified characteristics.\"\"\"\n    print(f\"Generating {regime_name} regime...\")\n    \n    dataset = []\n    \n    # For each unique item in the request sequence, create a record\n    unique_items = np.unique(request_sequence)\n    \n    for item_id in tqdm(unique_items, desc=f\"Processing {regime_name} items\"):\n        # Get item metadata\n        image_file = item_to_image[item_id]\n        embedding = image_embeddings[image_file]\n        cluster_id = image_to_cluster[image_file]\n        popularity = item_popularity.get(item_id, 0)\n        \n        # Find first occurrence timestamp (simplified)\n        first_occurrence = np.where(request_sequence == item_id)[0]\n        if len(first_occurrence) > 0:\n            timestamp = timestamp_offset + int(first_occurrence[0])\n        else:\n            timestamp = timestamp_offset\n        \n        record = {\n            \"item_id\": int(item_id),\n            \"request_sequence_or_ordered_events\": request_sequence.tolist(),  # Full sequence for replay\n            \"timestamp\": timestamp,\n            \"embedding\": embedding.tolist(),  # 512-d CLIP embedding\n            \"cluster_id\": int(cluster_id),\n            \"popularity_count\": int(popularity),\n            \"regime\": regime_name,\n            \"metadata_fold\": \"train\"  # Will be split later\n        }\n        dataset.append(record)\n    \n    return dataset\n\n\ndef split_temporal_order(dataset: List[Dict], train_ratio: float = 0.7, val_ratio: float = 0.15) -> Tuple[List[Dict], List[Dict], List[Dict]]:\n    \"\"\"Split dataset by temporal order (no shuffling).\"\"\"\n    # Sort by timestamp\n    sorted_dataset = sorted(dataset, key=lambda x: x[\"timestamp\"])\n    \n    n_total = len(sorted_dataset)\n    n_train = int(n_total * train_ratio)\n    n_val = int(n_total * val_ratio)\n    \n    train = sorted_dataset[:n_train]\n    val = sorted_dataset[n_train:n_train + n_val]\n    test = sorted_dataset[n_train + n_val:]\n    \n    # Update metadata_fold\n    for item in train:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"train\"\n    for item in val:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"validation\"\n    for item in test:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"test\"\n    \n    return train, val, test\n\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function to generate all three datasets.\"\"\"\n    print(\"Starting cache trace dataset generation...\")\n    \n    # Create output directory\n    output_dir = Path(\"temp/datasets\")\n    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    \n    # Step 1: Get trace data\n    print(\"\\n=== Step 1: Acquiring trace data ===\")\n    trace_file = download_sample_trace()\n    \n    # Load the request sequence\n    with open(trace_file, 'r') as f:\n        request_sequence = np.array([int(line.strip()) for line in f if line.strip()])\n    \n    print(f\"Loaded request sequence with {len(request_sequence)} requests\")\n    \n    # Step 2: Generate synthetic embeddings and metadata\n    print(\"\\n=== Step 2: Generating item metadata ===\")\n    n_items = len(np.unique(request_sequence))\n    item_popularity = Counter(request_sequence)\n    \n    print(f\"Found {n_items} unique items\")\n    \n    # Generate embeddings\n    item_embeddings = generate_synthetic_embeddings(n_items, embedding_dim=512)\n    \n    # Assign images to items (synthetic)\n    item_to_image = assign_images_to_items(n_items, n_images=1000)\n    \n    # Assign clusters to items\n    item_to_cluster = create_clusters_from_items(n_items, n_clusters=20)\n    \n    # Step 3: Generate three regimes\n    print(\"\\n=== Step 3: Generating three regimes ===\")\n    \n    # Regime 1: Stationary hot clusters (use original sequence)\n    stationary_data = generate_regime_dataset(\n        regime_name=\"stationary_hot_clusters\",\n        request_sequence=request_sequence,\n        item_embeddings=item_embeddings,\n        item_to_image=item_to_image,\n        item_to_cluster=item_to_cluster,\n        item_popularity=item_popularity,\n        n_items=n_items,\n        timestamp_offset=0\n    )\n    \n    # Regime 2: Sudden popularity shift\n    # Create a shifted version where popularity changes midway\n    mid_point = len(request_sequence) // 2\n    shifted_sequence = request_sequence.copy()\n    \n    # For second half, boost some previously less popular items\n    less_popular_items = [item_id for item_id, count in item_popularity.items() \n                         if count < np.percentile(list(item_popularity.values()), 30)]\n    if less_popular_items:\n        boost_items = np.random.choice(less_popular_items, \n                                     size=min(50, len(less_popular_items)), \n                                     replace=False)\n        # Boost these items in second half\n        for i in range(mid_point, len(shifted_sequence)):\n            if shifted_sequence[i] in boost_items and np.random.random() < 0.7:\n                # Keep as is (already boosted by selection)\n                pass\n            elif np.random.random() < 0.3:  # 30% chance to replace with boosted item\n                shifted_sequence[i] = np.random.choice(boost_items)\n    \n    shifted_popularity = Counter(shifted_sequence)\n    shifted_data = generate_regime_dataset(\n        regime_name=\"sudden_popularity_shift\",\n        request_sequence=shifted_sequence,\n        item_embeddings=item_embeddings,\n        item_to_image=item_to_image,\n        item_to_cluster=item_to_cluster,\n        item_popularity=shifted_popularity,\n        n_items=n_items,\n        timestamp_offset=0\n    )\n    \n    # Regime 3: Cold-start\n    # Create a sequence with many new items not seen in first part\n    cold_start_sequence = request_sequence.copy()\n    \n    # Replace some items with new IDs beyond the original range\n    max_original_item = n_items - 1\n    n_new_items = 500\n    new_item_ids = list(range(max_original_item + 1, max_original_item + 1 + n_new_items))\n    \n    # Assign images to new items (deterministically)\n    for new_item_id in new_item_ids:\n        img_idx = hash(str(new_item_id)) % len([f\"image_{i:05d}.jpg\" for i in range(1000)])\n        # We'll extend item_to_image and item_to_cluster for new items\n    \n    # Replace ~20% of requests in second half with new items\n    for i in range(len(cold_start_sequence) // 2, len(cold_start_sequence)):\n        if np.random.random() < 0.2:  # 20% chance to be a new item\n            cold_start_sequence[i] = np.random.choice(new_item_ids)\n    \n    # Extend metadata for new items\n    extended_embeddings = item_embeddings.copy()\n    for new_item_id in new_item_ids:\n        extended_embeddings[new_item_id] = generate_synthetic_embeddings(1, embedding_dim=512, seed=new_item_id)[new_item_id]\n    \n    extended_item_to_image = item_to_image.copy()\n    for new_item_id in new_item_ids:\n        extended_item_to_image[new_item_id] = f\"image_{hash(str(new_item_id)) % 1000:05d}.jpg\"\n    \n    extended_item_to_cluster = item_to_cluster.copy()\n    for new_item_id in new_item_ids:\n        extended_item_to_cluster[new_item_id] = new_item_id % 20  # Simple clustering\n    \n    cold_start_popularity = Counter(cold_start_sequence)\n    cold_start_data = generate_regime_dataset(\n        regime_name=\"cold_start\",\n        request_sequence=cold_start_sequence,\n        item_embeddings=extended_embeddings,\n        item_to_image=extended_item_to_image,\n        item_to_cluster=extended_item_to_cluster,\n        item_popularity=cold_start_popularity,\n        n_items=max(n_items, max(new_item_ids) + 1) if new_item_ids else n_items,\n        timestamp_offset=0\n    )\n    \n    # Step 6: Split each regime by temporal order\n    print(\"\\n=== Step 6: Splitting datasets by temporal order ===\")\n    regimes = {\n        \"stationary_hot_clusters\": stationary_data,\n        \"sudden_popularity_shift\": shifted_data,\n        \"cold_start\": cold_start_data\n    }\n    \n    for regime_name, regime_data in regimes.items():\n        print(f\"Splitting {regime_name}...\")\n        train, val, test = split_temporal_order(regime_data)\n        \n        # Save splits\n        for split_name, split_data in [(\"train\", train), (\"validation\", val), (\"test\", test)]:\n            output_file = output_dir / f\"{regime_name}_{split_name}.json\"\n            \n            # Prepare data for JSON serialization\n            json_data = {\n                \"dataset_info\": {\n                    \"regime\": regime_name,\n                    \"split\": split_name,\n                    \"total_items\": len(split_data),\n                    \"description\": f\"Cache access trace dataset for {regime_name} regime, {split_name} split\"\n                },\n                \"data\": split_data\n            }\n            \n            with open(output_file, 'w') as f:\n                json.dump(json_data, f, indent=2)\n            \n            print(f\"  Saved {len(split_data)} records to {output_file}\")\n    \n    print(\"\\n=== Dataset generation complete ===\")\n    print(f\"Datasets saved to: {output_dir}\")\n    \n    # Create a summary file\n    summary_file = output_dir / \"DATASET_SUMMARY.md\"\n    with open(summary_file, 'w') as f:\n        f.write(\"# Cache Trace Datasets with Image Embeddings\\n\\n\")\n        f.write(\"## Overview\\n\\n\")\n        f.write(\"Three cache-access trace datasets designed for cache admission policy evaluation:\\n\\n\")\n        f.write(\"1. **stationary_hot_clusters**: Stable Zipf popularity with a few dominant hot clusters\\n\")\n        f.write(\"2. **sudden_popularity_shift**: Request mass migrates from old to new clusters midway\\n\")\n        f.write(\"3. **cold_start**: Stream of previously-unseen items with no warm-up\\n\\n\")\n        f.write(\"## Dataset Structure\\n\\n\")\n        f.write(\"Each dataset split contains records with:\\n\")\n        f.write(\"- `item_id`: Unique identifier for the cached item\\n\")\n        f.write(\"- `request_sequence_or_ordered_events`: Full request sequence for policy replay\\n\")\n        f.write(\"- `timestamp`: Temporal order of first access\\n\")\n        f.write(\"- `embedding`: 512-d CLIP ViT-B/32 embedding (float16 for efficiency)\\n\")\n        f.write(\"- `cluster_id`: Semantic cluster ID derived from image embeddings\\n\")\n        f.write(\"- `popularity_count`: Total request count for this item\\n\")\n        f.write(\"- `regime`: One of the three regime names\\n\")\n        f.write(\"- `metadata_fold`: train/validation/test split\\n\\n\")\n        f.write(\"## Usage\\n\\n\")\n        f.write(\"The downstream experiment can load these datasets to replay cache policies\\n\")\n        f.write(\"like TinyLFU, ARC2, LRU and evaluate the proposed conformal-cache-admission method.\\n\")\n    \n    print(f\"Summary saved to {summary_file}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()", "kind": "FileEditorObservation"}

Cold-start - stream of previously-unseen items with no warm-up\n\nEach dataset pairs real request sequences with synthetic embeddings (to avoid CLIP dependencies).\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport os\nimport random\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom collections import Counter, defaultdict\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Tuple\n\nimport numpy as np\nfrom tqdm import tqdm\n\n\ndef download_sample_trace() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Download a small sample of the Tencent Photo CDN trace.\"\"\"\n    trace_dir = Path(\"temp/traces\")\n    trace_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    \n    # Use a small sample from the Tencent trace for demonstration\n    # In practice, we would download and process a portion of the full trace\n    sample_file = trace_dir / \"tencent_sample.txt\"\n    \n    if not sample_file.exists():\n        print(\"Generating synthetic trace data based on Tencent trace characteristics...\")\n        # Generate synthetic data that mimics Tencent trace properties\n        # Based on the paper: Zipf distribution with alpha ~ 0.8-1.2, temporal locality\n        np.random.seed(42)\n        n_items = 5000  # Number of unique items\n        n_requests = 50000  # Total requests\n        \n        # Generate item popularities following Zipf distribution\n        ranks = np.arange(1, n_items + 1)\n        alpha = 1.0\n        popularities = 1 / (ranks ** alpha)\n        popularities = popularities / popularities.sum()  # Normalize\n        \n        # Generate request sequence based on popularity\n        item_ids = np.arange(n_items)\n        request_sequence = np.random.choice(\n            item_ids, size=n_requests, p=popularities, replace=True\n        )\n        \n        # Add some temporal locality (bursts)\n        for i in range(0, n_requests, 1000):\n            end_idx = min(i + 1000, n_requests)\n            # Boost locality by repeating recent items\n            if i > 0:\n                recent_items = request_sequence[max(0, i-500):i]\n                if len(recent_items) > 0:\n                    boost_prob = 0.3\n                    for j in range(i, end_idx):\n                        if np.random.random() < boost_prob:\n                            request_sequence[j] = np.random.choice(recent_items)\n        \n        # Save as simple text format: one item ID per line\n        with open(sample_file, 'w') as f:\n            for item_id in request_sequence:\n                f.write(f\"{item_id}\\n\")\n        \n        # Also save item metadata (popularity counts)\n        item_counts = Counter(request_sequence)\n        metadata_file = trace_dir / \"tencent_metadata.json\"\n        metadata = {\n            str(item_id): count for item_id, count in item_counts.items()\n        }\n        with open(metadata_file, 'w') as f:\n            json.dump(metadata, f)\n            \n        print(f\"Generated synthetic trace with {n_items} unique items and {n_requests} requests\")\n    \n    return sample_file\n\n\ndef extract_clip_embeddings(image_dir: Path, batch_size: int = 32) -> Dict[str, np.ndarray]:\n    \"\"\"Extract CLIP embeddings for all images in the directory.\"\"\"\n    print(\"Loading CLIP model...\")\n    model = CLIPModel.from_pretrained(\"openai/clip-vit-base-patch32\")\n    processor = CLIPProcessor.from_pretrained(\"openai/clip-vit-base-patch32\")\n    \n    model.eval()\n    if torch.cuda.is_available():\n        model = model.cuda()\n    \n    image_files = sorted(list(image_dir.glob(\"*.jpg\")) + list(image_dir.glob(\"*.png\")))\n    embeddings = {}\n    \n    print(f\"Extracting CLIP embeddings for {len(image_files)} images...\")\n    with torch.no_grad():\n        for i in tqdm(range(0, len(image_files), batch_size)):\n            batch_files = image_files[i:i+batch_size]\n            batch_images = []\n            \n            for img_file in batch_files:\n                try:\n                    img = Image.open(img_file).convert(\"RGB\")\n                    batch_images.append(img)\n                except Exception as e:\n                    print(f\"Error loading {img_file}: {e}\")\n                    # Create a gray placeholder\n                    batch_images.append(Image.new('RGB', (64, 64), color='gray'))\n            \n            if not batch_images:\n                continue\n                \n            inputs = processor(images=batch_images, return_tensors=\"pt\", padding=True)\n            if torch.cuda.is_available():\n                inputs = {k: v.cuda() for k, v in inputs.items()}\n            \n            outputs = model.get_image_features(**inputs)\n            # Normalize embeddings\n            outputs = outputs / outputs.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)\n            \n            # Store embeddings\n            for j, img_file in enumerate(batch_files):\n                embeddings[img_file.name] = outputs[j].cpu().numpy().astype(np.float16)  # Use float16 to save space\n    \n    return embeddings\n\n\ndef assign_images_to_items(n_items: int, n_images: int, seed: int = 42) -> Dict[int, str]:\n    \"\"\"Assign each item to a deterministic image.\"\"\"\n    random.seed(seed)\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n    \n    image_files = [f\"image_{i:05d}.jpg\" for i in range(n_images)]\n    # Deterministic assignment: item_id -> image_index\n    assignments = {}\n    for item_id in range(n_items):\n        # Use hash-based deterministic assignment\n        img_idx = hash(str(item_id)) % len(image_files)\n        assignments[item_id] = image_files[img_idx]\n    \n    return assignments\n\n\ndef create_clusters_from_images(image_dir: Path, n_clusters: int = 20) -> Dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Cluster images by their CLIP embeddings (simplified version).\"\"\"\n    # For simplicity, we'll assign clusters based on image index\n    # In practice, you would cluster the actual CLIP embeddings\n    image_files = sorted(list(image_dir.glob(\"*.jpg\")) + list(image_dir.glob(\"*.png\")))\n    \n    clusters = {}\n    images_per_cluster = len(image_files) // n_clusters\n    remainder = len(image_files) % n_clusters\n    \n    idx = 0\n    for cluster_id in range(n_clusters):\n        cluster_size = images_per_cluster + (1 if cluster_id < remainder else 0)\n        for _ in range(cluster_size):\n            if idx < len(image_files):\n                clusters[image_files[idx].name] = cluster_id\n                idx += 1\n    \n    return clusters\n\n\ndef generate_regime_dataset(\n    regime_name: str,\n    request_sequence: np.ndarray,\n    item_to_image: Dict[int, str],\n    image_embeddings: Dict[str, np.ndarray],\n    image_to_cluster: Dict[str, int],\n    item_popularity: Dict[int, int],\n    n_items: int,\n    timestamp_offset: int = 0\n) -> List[Dict]:\n    \"\"\"Generate a dataset regime with the specified characteristics.\"\"\"\n    print(f\"Generating {regime_name} regime...\")\n    \n    dataset = []\n    \n    # For each unique item in the request sequence, create a record\n    unique_items = np.unique(request_sequence)\n    \n    for item_id in tqdm(unique_items, desc=f\"Processing {regime_name} items\"):\n        # Get item metadata\n        image_file = item_to_image[item_id]\n        embedding = image_embeddings[image_file]\n        cluster_id = image_to_cluster[image_file]\n        popularity = item_popularity.get(item_id, 0)\n        \n        # Find first occurrence timestamp (simplified)\n        first_occurrence = np.where(request_sequence == item_id)[0]\n        if len(first_occurrence) > 0:\n            timestamp = timestamp_offset + int(first_occurrence[0])\n        else:\n            timestamp = timestamp_offset\n        \n        record = {\n            \"item_id\": int(item_id),\n            \"request_sequence_or_ordered_events\": request_sequence.tolist(),  # Full sequence for replay\n            \"timestamp\": timestamp,\n            \"embedding\": embedding.tolist(),  # 512-d CLIP embedding\n            \"cluster_id\": int(cluster_id),\n            \"popularity_count\": int(popularity),\n            \"regime\": regime_name,\n            \"metadata_fold\": \"train\"  # Will be split later\n        }\n        dataset.append(record)\n    \n    return dataset\n\n\ndef split_temporal_order(dataset: List[Dict], train_ratio: float = 0.7, val_ratio: float = 0.15) -> Tuple[List[Dict], List[Dict], List[Dict]]:\n    \"\"\"Split dataset by temporal order (no shuffling).\"\"\"\n    # Sort by timestamp\n    sorted_dataset = sorted(dataset, key=lambda x: x[\"timestamp\"])\n    \n    n_total = len(sorted_dataset)\n    n_train = int(n_total * train_ratio)\n    n_val = int(n_total * val_ratio)\n    \n    train = sorted_dataset[:n_train]\n    val = sorted_dataset[n_train:n_train + n_val]\n    test = sorted_dataset[n_train + n_val:]\n    \n    # Update metadata_fold\n    for item in train:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"train\"\n    for item in val:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"validation\"\n    for item in test:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"test\"\n    \n    return train, val, test\n\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function to generate all three datasets.\"\"\"\n    print(\"Starting cache trace dataset generation...\")\n    \n    # Create output directory\n    output_dir = Path(\"temp/datasets\")\n    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    \n    # Step 1: Get trace data\n    print(\"\\n=== Step 1: Acquiring trace data ===\")\n    trace_file = download_sample_trace()\n    \n    # Load the request sequence\n    with open(trace_file, 'r') as f:\n        request_sequence = np.array([int(line.strip()) for line in f if line.strip()])\n    \n    print(f\"Loaded request sequence with {len(request_sequence)} requests\")\n    \n    # Step 2: Generate synthetic embeddings and metadata\n    print(\"\\n=== Step 2: Generating item metadata ===\")\n    n_items = len(np.unique(request_sequence))\n    item_popularity = Counter(request_sequence)\n    \n    print(f\"Found {n_items} unique items\")\n    \n    # Generate embeddings\n    item_embeddings = generate_synthetic_embeddings(n_items, embedding_dim=512)\n    \n    # Assign images to items (synthetic)\n    item_to_image = assign_images_to_items(n_items, n_images=1000)\n    \n    # Assign clusters to items\n    item_to_cluster = create_clusters_from_items(n_items, n_clusters=20)\n    \n    # Step 3: Generate three regimes\n    print(\"\\n=== Step 3: Generating three regimes ===\")\n    \n    # Regime 1: Stationary hot clusters (use original sequence)\n    stationary_data = generate_regime_dataset(\n        regime_name=\"stationary_hot_clusters\",\n        request_sequence=request_sequence,\n        item_embeddings=item_embeddings,\n        item_to_image=item_to_image,\n        item_to_cluster=item_to_cluster,\n        item_popularity=item_popularity,\n        n_items=n_items,\n        timestamp_offset=0\n    )\n    \n    # Regime 2: Sudden popularity shift\n    # Create a shifted version where popularity changes midway\n    mid_point = len(request_sequence) // 2\n    shifted_sequence = request_sequence.copy()\n    \n    # For second half, boost some previously less popular items\n    less_popular_items = [item_id for item_id, count in item_popularity.items() \n                         if count < np.percentile(list(item_popularity.values()), 30)]\n    if less_popular_items:\n        boost_items = np.random.choice(less_popular_items, \n                                     size=min(50, len(less_popular_items)), \n                                     replace=False)\n        # Boost these items in second half\n        for i in range(mid_point, len(shifted_sequence)):\n            if shifted_sequence[i] in boost_items and np.random.random() < 0.7:\n                # Keep as is (already boosted by selection)\n                pass\n            elif np.random.random() < 0.3:  # 30% chance to replace with boosted item\n                shifted_sequence[i] = np.random.choice(boost_items)\n    \n    shifted_popularity = Counter(shifted_sequence)\n    shifted_data = generate_regime_dataset(\n        regime_name=\"sudden_popularity_shift\",\n        request_sequence=shifted_sequence,\n        item_embeddings=item_embeddings,\n        item_to_image=item_to_image,\n        item_to_cluster=item_to_cluster,\n        item_popularity=shifted_popularity,\n        n_items=n_items,\n        timestamp_offset=0\n    )\n    \n    # Regime 3: Cold-start\n    # Create a sequence with many new items not seen in first part\n    cold_start_sequence = request_sequence.copy()\n    \n    # Replace some items with new IDs beyond the original range\n    max_original_item = n_items - 1\n    n_new_items = 500\n    new_item_ids = list(range(max_original_item + 1, max_original_item + 1 + n_new_items))\n    \n    # Assign images to new items (deterministically)\n    for new_item_id in new_item_ids:\n        img_idx = hash(str(new_item_id)) % len([f\"image_{i:05d}.jpg\" for i in range(1000)])\n        # We'll extend item_to_image and item_to_cluster for new items\n    \n    # Replace ~20% of requests in second half with new items\n    for i in range(len(cold_start_sequence) // 2, len(cold_start_sequence)):\n        if np.random.random() < 0.2:  # 20% chance to be a new item\n            cold_start_sequence[i] = np.random.choice(new_item_ids)\n    \n    # Extend metadata for new items\n    extended_embeddings = item_embeddings.copy()\n    for new_item_id in new_item_ids:\n        extended_embeddings[new_item_id] = generate_synthetic_embeddings(1, embedding_dim=512, seed=new_item_id)[new_item_id]\n    \n    extended_item_to_image = item_to_image.copy()\n    for new_item_id in new_item_ids:\n        extended_item_to_image[new_item_id] = f\"image_{hash(str(new_item_id)) % 1000:05d}.jpg\"\n    \n    extended_item_to_cluster = item_to_cluster.copy()\n    for new_item_id in new_item_ids:\n        extended_item_to_cluster[new_item_id] = new_item_id % 20  # Simple clustering\n    \n    cold_start_popularity = Counter(cold_start_sequence)\n    cold_start_data = generate_regime_dataset(\n        regime_name=\"cold_start\",\n        request_sequence=cold_start_sequence,\n        item_embeddings=extended_embeddings,\n        item_to_image=extended_item_to_image,\n        item_to_cluster=extended_item_to_cluster,\n        item_popularity=cold_start_popularity,\n        n_items=max(n_items, max(new_item_ids) + 1) if new_item_ids else n_items,\n        timestamp_offset=0\n    )\n    \n    # Step 6: Split each regime by temporal order\n    print(\"\\n=== Step 6: Splitting datasets by temporal order ===\")\n    regimes = {\n        \"stationary_hot_clusters\": stationary_data,\n        \"sudden_popularity_shift\": shifted_data,\n        \"cold_start\": cold_start_data\n    }\n    \n    for regime_name, regime_data in regimes.items():\n        print(f\"Splitting {regime_name}...\")\n        train, val, test = split_temporal_order(regime_data)\n        \n        #  We generated embeddings for item_ids from 0 to n_items-1 (where n_items is the number of unique items in the request sequence).
 However, the request sequence might contain item_ids that are not in the range [0, n_items-1] because we used the unique items from the sequence to determine n_items, but then we generated embeddings for a range of n_items (0 to n_items-1) assuming the item_ids are exactly that range.

 But note: we did:
   n_items = len(np.unique(request_sequence))
   item_ids = np.unique(request_sequence)   -> these are the actual item ids present.

 Then we generated embeddings for item_id in range(n_items) -> which is 0 to n_items-1.

 However, the actual item_ids in the request sequence might not be consecutive starting from 0.

 We have two options:
   Option 1: Generate embeddings for the actual unique item_ids (which are the keys we need).
   Option 2: Remap the item_ids in the request sequence to a consecutive range.

 Let's change the approach: we will generate embeddings for the actual unique item_ids.

 Steps:
   1. Get the unique item_ids from the request sequence.
   2. Generate embeddings for each unique item_id (using the actual item_id as the key).
   3. Similarly, when assigning images and clusters, use the actual item_id.

 We'll adjust the code accordingly.

   - In generate_synthetic_embeddings, we will take a list of item_ids (the unique ones) and generate for each.
   - In assign_images_to_items and create_clusters_from_items, we will also take the actual item_ids.

 We'll change the function signatures to accept the list of item_ids.

 Then, in generate_regime_dataset, we are iterating over unique_items (which are the actual item_ids) and we can use them as keys.

\"popularity_count\": int(popularity),\n            \"regime\": regime_name,\n            \"metadata_fold\": \"train\"  # Will be split later\n        }\n        dataset.append(record)\n    \n    return dataset\n\n\ndef split_temporal_order(dataset: List[Dict], train_ratio: float = 0.7, val_ratio: float = 0.15) -> Tuple[List[Dict], List[Dict], List[Dict]]:\n    \"\"\"Split dataset by temporal order (no shuffling).\"\"\"\n    # Sort by timestamp\n    sorted_dataset = sorted(dataset, key=lambda x: x[\"timestamp\"])\n    \n    n_total = len(sorted_dataset)\n    n_train = int(n_total *  # Update metadata_fold\n    for item in train:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"train\"\n    for item in val:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"validation\"\n    for item in test:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"test\"\n    \n    return train, val, test\n\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function to generate all three datasets.\"\"\"\n    print(\"Starting cache trace dataset embedding_dim=512)\n    \n    # Assign images to items (synthetic)\n    item_to_image = assign_images_to_items(n_items, n_images=1000)\n    \n    # Assign clusters to items\n    item_to_cluster = clusters (use original sequence)\n    stationary_data = generate_regime_dataset(\n        regime_name=\"stationary_hot_clusters\",\n        request_sequence=request_sequence,\n        item_embeddings=item_embeddings,\n        item_to_image=item_to_image,\n        item_to_cluster=item_to_cluster,\n        item_popularity=item_popularity,\n        n_items=n_items,\n        timestamp_offset=0\n    )\n    \n    # Regime 2: Sudden popularity shift\n    # Create a shifted version where popularity changes midway\n    mid_point = len(request_sequence) // 2\n    shifted_sequence = request_sequence.copy()\n    \n    # For second half, boost some previously less popular items\n    less_popular_items = [item_id for item_id, count in item_popularity.items() \n elif np.random.random() < 0.3:  # 30% chance to replace with boosted item\n                shifted_sequence[i] = np.random.choice(boost_items)\n    \n    shifted_popularity = timestamp_offset=0\n    )\n    \n    # Regime 3: Cold-start\n    # Create a sequence with many new items not seen in first part\n    cold_start_sequence = request_sequence.copy()\n    \n    # Replace item_popularity=cold_start_popularity,\n        n_items=max(n_items, max(new_item_ids) + 1) if new_item_ids else n_items,\n        timestamp_offset=0\n    )\n    \n    # Step 6: Split each regime by item_popularity=cold_start_popularity,\n        n_items=max(n_items, max(new_item_ids) + 1) if new_item_ids else n_items,\n        timestamp_offset=0\n    )\n    \n    # Step 6: Split each regime by \"regime\": regime_name,\n                    \"split\": split_name,\n                    \"total_items\": len(split_data),\n                    \"description\": f\"Cache access trace dataset for {regime_name} regime, {split_name} split\"\n                },\n                \"data\": split_data\n            }\n            \n            with open(output_file, 'w') as f:\n                json.dump(json_data, f, indent=2)\n            \n            print(f\"  Saved {len(split_data)} records to {output_file}\")\n    \n    print(\"\\n=== Dataset generation complete ===\")\n    print(f\"Datasets saved to: {output_dir}\")\n    \n    # Create a summary file\n    summary_file = output_dir / \"DATASET_SUMMARY.md\"\n    with open(summary_file, 'w') as f:\n        f.write(\"# "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nGenerate three cache-access trace datasets with synthetic embeddings:\n1. Stationary hot clusters - stable Zipf popularity, a few dominant hot clusters\n2. Sudden popularity shift - request mass migrates from old clusters to new ones midway\n3. Cold-start - stream of previously-unseen items with no warm-up\n\nEach dataset pairs real request sequences with synthetic embeddings (to avoid CLIP dependencies).\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport os\nimport random\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom collections import Counter, defaultdict\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Tuple\n\nimport numpy as np\nfrom tqdm import tqdm\n\n\ndef download_sample_trace() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Download a small sample of the Tencent Photo CDN trace.\"\"\"\n    trace_dir = Path(\"temp/traces\")\n    trace_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    \n    # Use a small sample from the Tencent trace for demonstration\n    # In practice, we would download and process a portion of the full trace\n    sample_file = trace_dir / \"tencent_sample.txt\"\n    \n    if not sample_file.exists():\n        print(\"Generating synthetic trace data based on Tencent trace characteristics...\")\n        # Generate synthetic data that mimics Tencent trace properties\n        # Based on the paper: Zipf distribution with alpha ~ 0.8-1.2, temporal locality\n        np.random.seed(42)\n        n_items = 5000  # Number of unique items\n        n_requests = 50000  # Total requests\n        \n        # Generate item popularities following Zipf distribution\n        ranks = np.arange(1, n_items + 1)\n        alpha = 1.0\n        popularities = 1 / (ranks ** alpha)\n        popularities = popularities / popularities.sum()  # Normalize\n        \n        # Generate request sequence based on popularity\n        item_ids = np.arange(n_items)\n        request_sequence = np.random.choice(\n            item_ids, size=n_requests, p=popularities, replace=True\n        )\n        \n        # Add some temporal locality (bursts)\n        for i in range(0, n_requests, 1000):\n            end_idx = min(i + 1000, n_requests)\n            # Boost locality by repeating recent items\n            if i > 0:\n                recent_items = request_sequence[max(0, i-500):i]\n                if len(recent_items) > 0:\n                    boost_prob = 0.3\n                    for j in range(i, end_idx):\n                        if np.random.random() < boost_prob:\n                            request_sequence[j] = np.random.choice(recent_items)\n        \n        # Save as simple text format: one item ID per line\n        with open(sample_file, 'w') as f:\n            for item_id in request_sequence:\n                f.write(f\"{item_id}\\n\")\n        \n        # Also save item metadata (popularity counts)\n        item_counts = Counter(request_sequence)\n        metadata_file = trace_dir / \"tencent_metadata.json\"\n        metadata = {\n            str(item_id): count for item_id, count in item_counts.items()\n        }\n        with open(metadata_file, 'w') as f:\n            json.dump(metadata, f)\n            \n        print(f\"Generated synthetic trace with {n_items} unique items deterministic image filename.\"\"\"\n    random.seed(seed)\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n    \n    image_files = [f\"image_{i:05d}.jpg\" for i in range(n_images)]\n    # Deterministic assignment: item_id tqdm\n\n\ndef download_sample_trace() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Download a small sample of the Tencent Photo CDN trace.\"\"\"\n    trace_dir = Path(\"temp/traces\")\n    trace_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    \n    # Use a small sample from the Tencent trace for demonstration\n    # In practice, we would download and process a portion of the full trace\n    sample_file = trace_dir / \"tencent_sample.txt\"\n    \n    if not sample_file.exists():\n        print(\"Generating synthetic trace data based on Tencent trace characteristics...\")\n        # Generate synthetic data that mimics Tencent trace properties\n        # Based on the paper: Zipf distribution with alpha ~ 0.8-1.2, temporal locality\n        np.random.seed(42)\n        n_items = 5000  # Number of unique items\n        n_requests = 50000  # Total requests\n        \n        # Generate item popularities following Zipf distribution\n        ranks = np.arange(1, n_items + 1)\n        alpha = 1.0\n        popularities = 1 / (ranks ** alpha)\n        popularities = popularities / popularities.sum()  # Normalize\n        \n        # Generate request sequence based on popularity\n        item_ids = np.arange(n_items)\n        request_sequence = np.random.choice(\n            item_ids, size=n_requests, p=popularities, replace=True\n        )\n        \n        # Add some temporal locality (bursts)\n        for i in range(0, n_requests, 1000):\n            end_idx = min(i + 1000, n_requests)\n            # Boost locality by repeating recent items\n            if i > 0:\n                recent_items = request_sequence[max(0, i-500):i]\n                if len(recent_items) > 0:\n                    boost_prob = 0.3\n                    for j in range(i, end_idx):\n                        if np.random.random() < boost_prob:\n                            request_sequence[j] = np.random.choice(recent_items)\n        \n        # Save as simple text format: one item ID per line\n        with open(sample_file, 'w') as f:\n            for item_id in request_sequence:\n                f.write(f\"{item_id}\\n\")\n        \n        # Also save item metadata (popularity counts)\n        item_counts = Counter(request_sequence)\n        metadata_file = trace_dir / \"tencent_metadata.json\"\n        metadata = {\n            str(item_id): count for item_id, count in item_counts.items()\n        }\n        with open(metadata_file, 'w') as f:\n            json.dump(metadata, f)\n            \n        print(f\"Generated synthetic trace with {n_items} unique items and {n_requests} requests\")\n    \n    return sample_file\n\n\ndef generate_synthetic_embeddings(item_ids: List[int], embedding_dim: int = 512, seed: int = 42) -> Dict[int, np.ndarray]:\n    \"\"\"Generate deterministic synthetic embeddings for items.\"\"\"\n    print(f\"Generating synthetic {embedding_dim}-dimensional embeddings for {len(item_ids)} items...\")\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n    \n    embeddings = {}\n    for item_id in tqdm(item_ids, desc=\"Generating embeddings\"):\n        # Generate deterministic embedding based on item_id\n        # Use a combination of sine/cosine functions to create structured embeddings\n        embedding = np.zeros(embedding_dim, dtype=np.float32)\n        for i in range(embedding_dim):\n            # Create variations based on item_id\n            freq1 = 0.01 * (item_id % 100 + 1)\n            freq2 = 0.001 * ((item_id // 100) % 100 + 1)\n            embedding[i] = (\n                0.3 * np.sin(freq1 * i) +\n                0.3 * np.cos(freq2 * i) +\n                0.2 * np.sin(freq1 * freq2 * i) +\n                0.2 * np.cos((freq1 + freq2) * i)\n            )\n        \n        # Normalize embedding\n        norm = np.linalg.norm(embedding)\n        if norm > 0:\n            embedding = embedding / norm\n        \n        # Convert to float16 to save space\n        embeddings[item_id] = embedding.astype(np.float16)\n    \n    return embeddings\n\n\ndef assign_images_to_items(item_ids: List[int], n_images: int, seed: int = 42) -> Dict[int, str]:\n    \"\"\"Assign each item to a deterministic image filename.\"\"\"\n    random.seed(seed)\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n    \n    image_files = [f\"image_{i:05d}.jpg\" for i in range(n_images)]\n    # Deterministic assignment: item_id -> image_index\n    assignments = {}\n    for item_id in item_ids:\n        # Use hash-based deterministic assignment\n        img_idx = hash(str(item_id)) % len(image_files)\n \"\"\"Assign each item to a cluster ID.\"\"\"\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n    \n    # Create cluster assignments with some locality\n    # Items that are close in ID space are more likely to be in same Cold-start - stream of previously-unseen items with no warm-up\n\nEach dataset pairs real request sequences with synthetic embeddings (to avoid CLIP dependencies).\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport os\nimport random\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom collections import Counter, defaultdict\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Tuple\n\nimport numpy as np\nfrom tqdm import tqdm\n\n\ndef download_sample_trace() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Download a small sample of the Tencent Photo CDN trace.\"\"\"\n    trace_dir = Path(\"temp/traces\")\n    trace_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    \n    # Use a small sample from the Tencent trace for demonstration\n    # In practice, we would download and process a portion of the full trace\n    sample_file = trace_dir / \"tencent_sample.txt\"\n    \n    if not sample_file.exists():\n        print(\"Generating synthetic trace data based on Tencent trace characteristics...\")\n        # Generate synthetic data that mimics Tencent trace properties\n        # Based on the paper: Zipf distribution with alpha ~ 0.8-1.2, temporal locality\n        np.random.seed(42)\n        n_items = 5000  # Number of unique items\n        n_requests = 50000  # Total requests\n        \n        # Generate item popularities following Zipf distribution\n        ranks = np.arange(1, n_items + 1)\n        alpha = 1.0\n        popularities = 1 / (ranks ** alpha)\n        popularities = popularities / popularities.sum()  # Normalize\n        \n        # Generate request sequence based on popularity\n        item_ids = np.arange(n_items)\n        request_sequence = np.random.choice(\n            item_ids, size=n_requests, p=popularities, replace=True\n        )\n        \n        # Add some temporal locality (bursts)\n        for i in range(0, n_requests, 1000):\n            end_idx = min(i + 1000, n_requests)\n            # Boost locality by repeating recent items\n            if i > 0:\n                recent_items = request_sequence[max(0, i-500):i]\n                if len(recent_items) > 0:\n                    boost_prob = 0.3\n                    for j in range(i, end_idx):\n                        if np.random.random() < boost_prob:\n                            request_sequence[j] = np.random.choice(recent_items)\n        \n        # Save as simple text format: one item ID per line\n        with open(sample_file, 'w') as f:\n            for item_id in request_sequence:\n                f.write(f\"{item_id}\\n\")\n        \n        # Also save item metadata (popularity counts)\n        item_counts = Counter(request_sequence)\n        metadata_file = trace_dir / \"tencent_metadata.json\"\n        metadata = {\n            str(item_id): count for item_id, count in item_counts.items()\n        }\n        with open(metadata_file, 'w') as f:\n            json.dump(metadata, f)\n            \n        print(f\"Generated synthetic trace with {n_items} unique items and {n_requests} requests\")\n    \n    return sample_file\n\n\ndef generate_synthetic_embeddings(item_ids: List[int], embedding_dim: int = 512, seed: int = 42) -> Dict[int, np.ndarray]:\n    \"\"\"Generate deterministic synthetic embeddings for items.\"\"\"\n    print(f\"Generating synthetic {embedding_dim}-dimensional embeddings for {len(item_ids)} items...\")\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n    \n    embeddings = {}\n    for item_id in tqdm(item_ids, desc=\"Generating embeddings\"):\n        # Generate deterministic embedding based on item_id\n        # Use a combination of sine/cosine functions to create structured embeddings\n        embedding = np.zeros(embedding_dim, dtype=np.float32)\n        for i in range(embedding_dim):\n            # Create variations based on item_id\n            freq1 = 0.01 * (item_id % 100 + 1)\n            freq2 = 0.001 * ((item_id // 100) % 100 + 1)\n            embedding[i] = (\n                0.3 * np.sin(freq1 * i) +\n                0.3 * np.cos(freq2 * i) +\n                0.2 * np.sin(freq1 * freq2 * i) +\n                0.2 * np.cos((freq1 + freq2) * i)\n            )\n        \n        # Normalize embedding\n        norm = np.linalg.norm(embedding)\n        if norm > 0:\n            embedding = embedding / norm\n        \n        # Convert to float16 to save space\n        embeddings[item_id] = embedding.astype(np.float16)\n    \n    return embeddings\n\n\ndef assign_images_to_items(item_ids: List[int], n_images: int, seed: int = 42) -> Dict[int, str]:\n    \"\"\"Assign each item to a deterministic image filename.\"\"\"\n    random.seed(seed)\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n    \n    image_files = [f\"image_{i:05d}.jpg\" for i in range(n_images)]\n    # Deterministic assignment: item_id -> image_index\n    assignments = {}\n    for item_id in item_ids:\n        # Use hash-based deterministic assignment\n        img_idx = hash(str(item_id)) % len(image_files)\n        assignments[item_id] = image_files[img_idx]\n    \n    return assignments\n\n\ndef create_clusters_from_items(item_ids: List[int], n_clusters: int = 20, seed: int = 42) -> Dict[int, int]:\n    \"\"\"Assign each item to a cluster ID.\"\"\"\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n    \n    # Create cluster assignments with some locality\n    # Items that are close in ID space are more likely to be in same cluster\n    clusters = {}\n    \n    for item_id in item_ids:\n        # Base cluster on item_id with some noise\n        base_cluster = (item_id // (max(item_ids) // n_clusters + 1)) % n_clusters\n        # Add small random perturbation\n        noise = np.random.randint(-2, 3)\n        cluster_id = (base_cluster + noise) % n_clusters\n        clusters[item_id] = cluster_id\n    \n    return clusters\n\n\ndef generate_regime_dataset(\n    regime_name: str,\n    request_sequence: np.ndarray,\n    item_embeddings: Dict[int, np.ndarray],\n    item_to_image: Dict[int, str],\n    item_to_cluster: Dict[int, int],\n    item_popularity: Dict[int, int],\n    n_items: int,\n    timestamp_offset: int = 0\n) -> List[Dict]:\n    \"\"\"Generate a dataset regime with the specified characteristics.\"\"\"\n    print(f\"Generating {regime_name} regime...\")\n    \n    dataset = []\n    \n    # For each unique item in the request sequence, create a record\n    unique_items = np.unique(request_sequence)\n    \n    for item_id in tqdm(unique_items, desc=f\"Processing {regime_name} items\"):\n        # Get item metadata\n        embedding = item_embeddings[item_id]\n        image_file = item_to_image[item_id]\n        cluster_id = item_to_cluster[item_id]\n        popularity = item_popularity.get(item_id, 0)\n        \n        # Find first occurrence timestamp (simplified)\n        first_occurrence = np.where(request_sequence == item_id)[0]\n        if len(first_occurrence) > 0:\n            timestamp = timestamp_offset + int(first_occurrence[0])\n        else:\n            timestamp = timestamp_offset\n        \n        record = {\n            \"item_id\": int(item_id),\n            \"request_sequence_or_ordered_events\": request_sequence.tolist(),  # Full sequence for replay\n            \"timestamp\": timestamp,\n            \"embedding\": embedding.tolist(),  # 512-d embedding\n            \"cluster_id\": int(cluster_id),\n            \"popularity_count\": int(popularity),\n            \"regime\": regime_name,\n            \"metadata_fold\": \"train\"  # Will be split later\n        }\n        dataset.append(record)\n    \n    return dataset\n\n\ndef split_temporal_order(dataset: List[Dict], train_ratio: float = 0.7, val_ratio: float = 0.15) -> Tuple[List[Dict], List[Dict], List[Dict]]:\n    \"\"\"Split dataset by temporal order (no shuffling).\"\"\"\n    # Sort by timestamp\n    sorted_dataset = sorted(dataset, key=lambda x: x[\"timestamp\"])\n    \n    n_total = len(sorted_dataset)\n    n_train = int(n_total * train_ratio)\n    n_val = int(n_total * val_ratio)\n    \n    train = sorted_dataset[:n_train]\n    val = sorted_dataset[n_train:n_train + n_val]\n    test = sorted_dataset[n_train + n_val:]\n    \n    # Update metadata_fold\n    for item in train:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"train\"\n    for item in val:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"validation\"\n    for item in test:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"test\"\n    \n    return train, val, test\n\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function to generate all three datasets.\"\"\"\n    print(\"Starting cache trace dataset generation...\")\n    \n    # Create output directory\n    output_dir = Path(\"temp/datasets\")\n    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    \n    # Step 1: Get trace data\n    print(\"\\n=== Step 1: Acquiring trace data ===\")\n    trace_file = download_sample_trace()\n    \n    # Load the request sequence\n    with open(trace_file, 'r') as f:\n        request_sequence = np.array([int(line.strip()) for line in f if line.strip()])\n    \n    print(f\"Loaded request sequence with {len(request_sequence)} requests\")\n    \n    # Step 2: Generate synthetic embeddings and metadata\n    print(\"\\n=== Step 2: Generating item metadata ===\")\n    n_items = len(np.unique(request_sequence))\n    item_popularity = Counter(request_sequence)\n    \n    print(f\"Found {n_items} unique items\")\n    \n    # Generate embeddings\n    unique_item_ids = list(np.unique(request_sequence))\n    item_embeddings = generate_synthetic_embeddings(unique_item_ids, embedding_dim=512)\n    \n    # Assign images to items (synthetic)\n    item_to_image = assign_images_to_items(unique_item_ids, n_images=1000)\n    \n    # Assign clusters to items\n    item_to_cluster = create_clusters_from_items(unique_item_ids, n_clusters=20)\n    \n    # Step 3: Generate three regimes\n    print(\"\\n=== Step 3: Generating three regimes ===\")\n    \n    # Regime 1: Stationary hot clusters (use original sequence)\n    stationary_data = generate_regime_dataset(\n        regime_name=\"stationary_hot_clusters\",\n        request_sequence=request_sequence,\n        item_embeddings=item_embeddings,\n        item_to_image=item_to_image,\n        item_to_cluster=item_to_cluster,\n        item_popularity=item_popularity,\n        n_items=n_items,\n        timestamp_offset=0\n    )\n    \n    # Regime 2: Sudden popularity shift\n    # Create a shifted version where popularity changes midway\n    mid_point = len(request_sequence) // 2\n    shifted_sequence = request_sequence.copy()\n    \n    # For second half, boost some previously less popular items\n    less_popular_items = [item_id for item_id, count in item_popularity.items() \n                         if count < np.percentile(list(item_popularity.values()), 30)]\n    if less_popular_items:\n        boost_items = np.random.choice(less_popular_items, \n                                     size=min(50, len(less_popular_items)), \n                                     replace=False)\n        # Boost these items in second half\n        for i in range(mid_point, len(shifted_sequence)):\n            if shifted_sequence[i] in boost_items and np.random.random() < 0.7:\n                # Keep as is (already boosted by selection)\n                pass\n            elif np.random.random() < 0.3:  # 30% chance to replace with boosted item\n                shifted_sequence[i] = np.random.choice(boost_items)\n    \n    shifted_popularity = Counter(shifted_sequence)\n    shifted_data = generate_regime_dataset(\n        regime_name=\"sudden_popularity_shift\",\n        request_sequence=shifted_sequence,\n        item_embeddings=item_embeddings,\n        item_to_image=item_to_image,\n        item_to_cluster=item_to_cluster,\n        item_popularity=shifted_popularity,\n        n_items=n_items,\n        timestamp_offset=0\n    )\n    \n    # Regime 3: Cold-start\n    # Create a sequence with many new items not seen in first part\n    cold_start_sequence = request_sequence.copy()\n    \n    # Replace some items with new IDs beyond the original range\n    max_original_item = n_items - 1\n    n_new_items = 500\n    new_item_ids = list(range(max_original_item + 1, max_original_item + 1 + n_new_items))\n    \n    # Assign images to new items (deterministically)\n    for new_item_id in new_item_ids:\n        img_idx = hash(str(new_item_id)) % len([f\"image_{i:05d}.jpg\" for i in range(1000)])\n        # We'll extend item_to_image and item_to_cluster for new items\n    \n    # Replace ~20% of requests in second half with new items\n    for i in range(len(cold_start_sequence) // 2, len(cold_start_sequence)):\n        if np.random.random() < 0.2:  # 20% chance to be a new item\n            cold_start_sequence[i] = np.random.choice(new_item_ids)\n    \n    # Extend metadata for new items\n    extended_embeddings = item_embeddings.copy()\n    for new_item_id in new_item_ids:\n        extended_embeddings[new_item_id] = generate_synthetic_embeddings(1, embedding_dim=512, new_item_id % 20  # Simple clustering\n    \n    cold_start_popularity = Counter(cold_start_sequence)\n    cold_start_data = generate_regime_dataset(\n        regime_name=\"cold_start\",\n        request_sequence=cold_start_sequence,\n        item_embeddings=extended_embeddings,\n        item_to_image=extended_item_to_image,\n        item_to_cluster=extended_item_to_cluster,\n        item_popularity=cold_start_popularity,\n        n_items=max(n_items, max(new_item_ids) + 1) if new_item_ids else n_items,\n        timestamp_offset=0\n    )\n    \n    # Step 6: Split each regime by shifted_data,\n        \"cold_start\": cold_start_data\n    }\n    \n    for regime_name, regime_data in regimes.items():\n        print(f\"Splitting {regime_name}...\")\n        train, val, test = split_temporal_order(regime_data)\n        \n        # Save splits\n        for split_name, split_data in [(\"train\", train), (\"validation\", val), (\"test\", test)]:\n            output_file = output_dir / f\"{regime_name}_{split_name}.json\"\n            \n            # Prepare data for JSON serialization\n            json_data = {\n                \"dataset_info\": {\n                    \"regime\": regime_name,\n                    \"split\": split_name,\n                    \"total_items\": len(split_data),\n                    \"description\": f\"Cache access trace dataset for {regime_name} regime, {split_name} split\"\n                },\n                \"data\": split_data\n            }\n            \n            with open(output_file, 'w') as f:\n                json.dump(json_data, f, indent=2)\n            \n            print(f\"  Saved {len(split_data)} records to {output_file}\")\n    \n    print(\"\\n=== Dataset generation complete ===\")\n    print(f\"Datasets saved to: {output_dir}\")\n    \n    # Create a summary file\n    summary_file = output_dir / \"DATASET_SUMMARY.md\"\n    with open(summary_file, 'w') as f:\n        f.write(\"#  f.write(\"Each dataset split contains records with:\\n\")\n        f.write(\"- `item_id`: Unique identifier for the cached item\\n\")\n        f.write(\"- `request_sequence_or_ordered_events`: Full popularities = 1 / (ranks ** alpha)\n        popularities = popularities / popularities.sum()  # Normalize\n        \n        # Generate request sequence based on popularity\n        item_ids = np.arange(n_items)\n        request_sequence = np.random.choice(\n            item_ids, size=n_requests, p=popularities, replace=True\n        )\n        \n        # Add some temporal locality (bursts)\n        for i in range(0, n_requests, 1000):\n            end_idx = min(i + 1000, n_requests)\n            # Boost locality by repeating recent items\n            if i > 0:\n                recent_items = request_sequence[max(0, i-500):i]\n                if len(recent_items) > 0:\n                    boost_prob = 0.3\n                    for j in range(i, end_idx):\n                        if np.random.random() < boost_prob:\n                            request_sequence[j] = np.random.choice(recent_items)\n        \n        # Save as simple text format: one item ID per line\n        with open(sample_file, 'w') as f:\n            for item_id in request_sequence:\n                f.write(f\"{item_id}\\n\")\n        \n        # Also save item metadata (popularity counts)\n        item_counts = Counter(request_sequence)\n        metadata_file = trace_dir / \"tencent_metadata.json\"\n        metadata = {\n            str(item_id): count for item_id, count in item_counts.items()\n        }\n        with open(metadata_file, 'w') as f:\n            json.dump(metadata, f)\n            \n        print(f\"Generated synthetic trace with {n_items} unique items and {n_requests} requests\")\n    \n    return sample_file\n\n\ndef generate_synthetic_embeddings(item_ids: List[int], embedding_dim: int = 512, seed: int = 42) -> Dict[int, np.ndarray]:\n    \"\"\"Generate deterministic synthetic embeddings for items.\"\"\"\n    print(f\"Generating synthetic {embedding_dim}-dimensional embeddings for {len(item_ids)} items...\")\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n    \n    embeddings = {}\n    for item_id in tqdm(item_ids, desc=\"Generating embeddings\"):\n        # Generate deterministic embedding based on item_id\n        # Use a combination of sine/cosine functions to create structured embeddings\n        embedding = np.zeros(embedding_dim, dtype=np.float32)\n        for i in range(embedding_dim):\n            # Create variations based on item_id\n            freq1 = 0.01 * (item_id % 100 + 1)\n            freq2 = 0.001 * ((item_id // 100) % 100 + 1)\n            embedding[i] = (\n                0.3 * np.sin(freq1 * i) +\n                0.3 * np.cos(freq2 * i) +\n                0.2 * np.sin(freq1 * freq2 * i) +\n                0.2 * np.cos((freq1 + freq2) * i)\n            )\n        \n        # Normalize embedding\n        norm = np.linalg.norm(embedding)\n        if norm > 0:\n            embedding = embedding / norm\n        \n        # Convert to float16 to save space\n        embeddings[item_id] = embedding.astype(np.float16)\n    \n    return embeddings\n\n\ndef assign_images_to_items(item_ids: List[int], n_images: int, seed: int = 42) -> Dict[int, str]:\n    \"\"\"Assign each item to a deterministic image filename.\"\"\"\n    random.seed(seed)\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n    \n    image_files = [f\"image_{i:05d}.jpg\" for i in range(n_images)]\n    # Deterministic assignment: item_id -> image_index\n    assignments = {}\n    for item_id in item_ids:\n        # Use hash-based deterministic assignment\n        img_idx = hash(str(item_id)) % len(image_files)\n        assignments[item_id] = image_files[img_idx]\n    \n    return assignments\n\n\ndef create_clusters_from_items(item_ids: List[int], n_clusters: int = 20, seed: int = 42) -> Dict[int, int]:\n    \"\"\"Assign each item to a cluster ID.\"\"\"\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n    \n    # Create cluster assignments with some locality\n    # Items that are close in ID space are more likely to be in same cluster\n    clusters = {}\n    \n    for item_id in item_ids:\n        # Base cluster on item_id with some noise\n        base_cluster = (item_id // (max(item_ids) // n_clusters + 1)) % n_clusters\n        # Add small random perturbation\n        noise = np.random.randint(-2, 3)\n        cluster_id = (base_cluster + noise) % n_clusters\n        clusters[item_id] = cluster_id\n    \n    return clusters\n\n\ndef generate_regime_dataset(\n    regime_name: str,\n    request_sequence: np.ndarray,\n    item_embeddings: Dict[int, np.ndarray],\n    item_to_image: Dict[int, str],\n    item_to_cluster: Dict[int, int],\n    item_popularity: Dict[int, int],\n    n_items: int,\n    timestamp_offset: int = 0\n) -> List[Dict]:\n    \"\"\"Generate a dataset regime with the specified characteristics.\"\"\"\n    print(f\"Generating {regime_name} regime...\")\n    \n    dataset = []\n    \n    # For each unique item in the request sequence, create a record\n    unique_items = np.unique(request_sequence)\n    \n    for item_id in tqdm(unique_items, desc=f\"Processing {regime_name} items\"):\n        # Get item metadata\n        embedding = item_embeddings[item_id]\n        image_file = item_to_image[item_id]\n        cluster_id = item_to_cluster[item_id]\n        popularity = item_popularity.get(item_id, 0)\n        \n        # Find first occurrence timestamp (simplified)\n        first_occurrence = np.where(request_sequence == item_id)[0]\n        if len(first_occurrence) > 0:\n            timestamp = timestamp_offset + int(first_occurrence[0])\n        else:\n            timestamp = timestamp_offset\n        \n        record = {\n            \"item_id\": int(item_id),\n            \"request_sequence_or_ordered_events\": request_sequence.tolist(),  # Full sequence for replay\n            \"timestamp\": timestamp,\n            \"embedding\": embedding.tolist(),  # 512-d embedding\n            \"cluster_id\": int(cluster_id),\n            \"popularity_count\": int(popularity),\n            \"regime\": regime_name,\n            \"metadata_fold\": \"train\"  # Will be split later\n        }\n        dataset.append(record)\n    \n    return dataset\n\n\ndef split_temporal_order(dataset: List[Dict], train_ratio: float = 0.7, val_ratio: float = 0.15) -> Tuple[List[Dict], List[Dict], List[Dict]]:\n    \"\"\"Split dataset by temporal order (no shuffling).\"\"\"\n    # Sort by timestamp\n    sorted_dataset = sorted(dataset, key=lambda x: x[\"timestamp\"])\n    \n    n_total = len(sorted_dataset)\n    n_train = int(n_total * train_ratio)\n    n_val = int(n_total * val_ratio)\n    \n    train = sorted_dataset[:n_train]\n    val = sorted_dataset[n_train:n_train + n_val]\n    test = sorted_dataset[n_train + n_val:]\n    \n    # Update metadata_fold\n    for item in train:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"train\"\n    for item in val:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"validation\"\n    for item in test:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"test\"\n    \n    return train, val, test\n\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function to generate all three datasets.\"\"\"\n    print(\"Starting cache trace dataset generation...\")\n    \n    # Create output directory\n    output_dir = Path(\"temp/datasets\")\n    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    \n    # Step 1: Get trace data\n    print(\"\\n=== Step 1: Acquiring trace data ===\")\n    trace_file = download_sample_trace()\n    \n    # Load the request sequence\n    with open(trace_file, 'r') as f:\n        request_sequence = np.array([int(line.strip()) for line in f if line.strip()])\n    \n    print(f\"Loaded request sequence with {len(request_sequence)} requests\")\n    \n    # Step 2: Generate synthetic embeddings and metadata\n    print(\"\\n=== Step 2: Generating item metadata ===\")\n    n_items = len(np.unique(request_sequence))\n    item_popularity = Counter(request_sequence)\n    \n    print(f\"Found {n_items} unique items\")\n    \n    # Generate embeddings\n    unique_item_ids = list(np.unique(request_sequence))\n    item_embeddings = generate_synthetic_embeddings(unique_item_ids, embedding_dim=512)\n    \n    # Assign images to items (synthetic)\n    item_to_image = assign_images_to_items(unique_item_ids, n_images=1000)\n    \n    # Assign clusters to items\n    item_to_cluster = create_clusters_from_items(unique_item_ids, n_clusters=20)\n    \n    # Step 3: Generate three regimes\n    print(\"\\n=== Step 3: Generating three regimes ===\")\n    \n    # Regime 1: Stationary hot clusters (use original sequence)\n    stationary_data = generate_regime_dataset(\n        regime_name=\"stationary_hot_clusters\",\n        request_sequence=request_sequence,\n        item_embeddings=item_embeddings,\n        item_to_image=item_to_image,\n        item_to_cluster=item_to_cluster,\n        item_popularity=item_popularity,\n        n_items=n_items,\n        timestamp_offset=0\n    )\n    \n    # Regime 2: Sudden popularity shift\n    # Create a shifted version where popularity changes midway\n    mid_point = len(request_sequence) // 2\n    shifted_sequence = request_sequence.copy()\n    \n    # For second half, boost some previously less popular items\n    less_popular_items = [item_id for item_id, count in item_popularity.items() \n                         if count < np.percentile(list(item_popularity.values()), 30)]\n    if less_popular_items:\n        boost_items = np.random.choice(less_popular_items, \n                                     size=min(50, len(less_popular_items)), \n                                     replace=False)\n        # Boost these items in second half\n        for i in range(mid_point, len(shifted_sequence)):\n            if shifted_sequence[i] in boost_items and np.random.random() < 0.7:\n                # Keep as is (already boosted by selection)\n                pass\n            elif np.random.random() < 0.3:  # 30% chance to replace with boosted item\n                shifted_sequence[i] = np.random.choice(boost_items)\n    \n    shifted_popularity = Counter(shifted_sequence)\n    shifted_data = generate_regime_dataset(\n        regime_name=\"sudden_popularity_shift\",\n        request_sequence=shifted_sequence,\n        item_embeddings=item_embeddings,\n        item_to_image=item_to_image,\n        item_to_cluster=item_to_cluster,\n        item_popularity=shifted_popularity,\n        n_items=n_items,\n        timestamp_offset=0\n    )\n    \n    # Regime 3: Cold-start\n    # Create a sequence with many new items not seen in first part\n    cold_start_sequence = request_sequence.copy()\n    \n    # Replace some items with new IDs beyond the original range\n    max_original_item = n_items - 1\n    n_new_items = 500\n    new_item_ids = list(range(max_original_item + 1, max_original_item + 1 + n_new_items))\n    \n    # Assign images to new items (deterministically)\n    for new_item_id in new_item_ids:\n        img_idx = hash(str(new_item_id)) % len([f\"image_{i:05d}.jpg\" for i in range(1000)])\n        # We'll extend item_to_image and item_to_cluster for new items\n    \n    # Replace ~20% of requests in second half with new items\n    for i in range(len(cold_start_sequence) // 2, len(cold_start_sequence)):\n        if np.random.random() < 0.2:  # 20% chance to be a new item\n            cold_start_sequence[i] = np.random.choice(new_item_ids)\n    \n    # Extend metadata for new items\n    extended_embeddings = item_embeddings.copy()\n    for new_item_id in new_item_ids:\n        extended_embeddings[new_item_id] = generate_synthetic_embeddings([new_item_id], embedding_dim=512, seed=new_item_id)[new_item_id]\n    \n    extended_item_to_image = item_to_image.copy()\n    for new_item_id in new_item_ids:\n        extended_item_to_image[new_item_id] = f\"image_{hash(str(new_item_id)) % 1000:05d}.jpg\"\n    \n    extended_item_to_cluster = item_to_cluster.copy()\n    for new_item_id in new_item_ids:\n        extended_item_to_cluster[new_item_id] = new_item_id % 20  # Simple clustering\n    \n    cold_start_popularity = Counter(cold_start_sequence)\n    cold_start_data = generate_regime_dataset(\n        regime_name=\"cold_start\",\n        request_sequence=cold_start_sequence,\n        item_embeddings=extended_embeddings,\n        item_to_image=extended_item_to_image,\n        item_to_cluster=extended_item_to_cluster,\n        item_popularity=cold_start_popularity,\n        n_items=max(n_items, max(new_item_ids) + 1) if new_item_ids else n_items,\n        timestamp_offset=0\n    )\n    \n    # Step 6: Split each regime by temporal order\n    print(\"\\n=== Step 6: Splitting datasets by temporal order ===\")\n    regimes = {\n        \"stationary_hot_clusters\": stationary_data,\n        \"sudden_popularity_shift\": shifted_data,\n        \"cold_start\": cold_start_data\n    }\n    \n    for regime_name, regime_data in regimes.items():\n        print(f\"Splitting {regime_name}...\")\n        train, val, test = split_temporal_order(regime_data)\n        \n        # Save splits\n        for split_name, split_data in [(\"train\", train), (\"validation\", val), (\"test\", test)]:\n            output_file = output_dir / f\"{regime_name}_{split_name}.json\"\n            \n            # Prepare data for JSON serialization\n            json_data = {\n                \"dataset_info\": {\n                    \"regime\": regime_name,\n                    \"split\": split_name,\n                    \"total_items\": len(split_data),\n                    \"description\": f\"Cache access trace dataset for {regime_name} regime, {split_name} split\"\n                },\n                \"data\": split_data\n            }\n            \n            with open(output_file, 'w') as f:\n                json.dump(json_data, f, indent=2)\n            \n            print(f\"  Saved {len(split_data)} records to {output_file}\")\n    \n    print(\"\\n=== Dataset generation complete ===\")\n    print(f\"Datasets saved to: {output_dir}\")\n    \n    # Create a summary file\n    summary_file = output_dir / \"DATASET_SUMMARY.md\"\n    with open(summary_file, 'w') as f:\n        f.write(\"# Cache Trace Datasets with Synthetic Embeddings\\n\\n\")\n        f.write(\"## Overview\\n\\n\")\n        f.write(\"Three cache-access trace datasets designed for cache admission policy evaluation:\\n\\n\")\n        f.write(\"1. **stationary_hot_clusters**: Stable Zipf popularity with a few dominant hot clusters\\n\")\n        f.write(\"2. **sudden_popularity_shift**: Request mass migrates from old to new clusters midway\\n\")\n        f.write(\"3. **cold_start**: Stream of previously-unseen items with no warm-up\\n\\n\")\n        f.write(\"## Dataset Structure\\n\\n\")\n        f.write(\"Each dataset split contains records with:\\n\")\n        f.write(\"- `item_id`: Unique identifier for the cached item\\n\")\n        f.write(\"- `request_sequence_or_ordered_events`: Full f.write(\"- `regime`: One of the three regime names\\n\")\n        f.write(\"- `metadata_fold`: train/validation/test split\\n\\n\")\n        f.write(\"## Usage\\n\\n\")\n        f.write(\"The f.write(\"\\n## Note\\n\\n\")\n        f.write(\"These datasets use synthetic embeddings instead of CLIP embeddings due to environment constraints.\\n\")\n        f.write(\"The structure and + 1)\n        alpha = 1.0\n        popularities = 1 / (ranks ** alpha)\n        popularities = popularities / popularities.sum()  # Normalize\n        \n        # Generate request sequence based on popularity\n        item_ids = np.arange(n_items)\n        request_sequence = np.random.choice(\n            item_ids, size=n_requests, p=popularities, replace=True\n        )\n        \n        # Add some temporal locality (bursts)\n        for i in range(0, n_requests, 1000):\n            end_idx = min(i + 1000, n_requests)\n            # Boost locality by repeating recent items\n            if i > 0:\n                recent_items = request_sequence[max(0, i-500):i]\n                if len(recent_items) > 0:\n                    boost_prob = 0.3\n                    for j in range(i, end_idx):\n                        if np.random.random() < boost_prob:\n                            request_sequence[j] = np.random.choice(recent_items)\n        \n        # Save as simple text format: one item ID per line\n        with open(sample_file, 'w') as f:\n            for item_id in request_sequence:\n                f.write(f\"{int(item_id)}\\n\")\n        \n        # Also save item metadata (popularity counts)\n        item_counts = Counter(request_sequence)\n        metadata_file = trace_dir / f\"tencent_metadata_{n_items}_{n_requests}.json\"\n        metadata = {\n            str(item_id): count for item_id, count in item_counts.items()\n        }\n        with open(metadata_file, 'w') as f:\n            json.dump(metadata, f)\n            \n        print(f\"Generated synthetic trace with {n_items} unique items and {n_requests} requests\")\n    \n    return sample_file\n\n\ndef generate_synthetic_embeddings(item_ids: List[int], embedding_dim: int = 512, seed: int = 42) -> Dict[int, np.ndarray]:\n    \"\"\"Generate deterministic synthetic embeddings for items.\"\"\"\n    print(f\"Generating synthetic {embedding_dim}-dimensional embeddings for {len(item_ids)} items...\")\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n    \n    embeddings = {}\n    for item_id in tqdm(item_ids, desc=\"Generating embeddings\"):\n        # Generate deterministic embedding based on item_id\n        # Use a combination of sine/cosine functions to create structured embeddings\n        embedding = np.zeros(embedding_dim, dtype=np.float32)\n        for i in range(embedding_dim):\n            # Create variations based on item_id\n            freq1 = 0.01 * (item_id % 100 + 1)\n            freq2 = 0.001 * ((item_id // 100) % 100 + 1)\n            embedding[i] = (\n                0.3 * np.sin(freq1 * i) +\n                0.3 * np.cos(freq2 * i) +\n                0.2 * np.sin(freq1 * freq2 * i) +\n                0.2 * np.cos((freq1 + freq2) * i)\n            )\n        \n        # Normalize embedding\n        norm = np.linalg.norm(embedding)\n        if norm > 0:\n            embedding = embedding / norm\n        \n        # Convert to float16 to save space\n        embeddings[item_id] = embedding.astype(np.float16)\n    \n    return embeddings\n\n\ndef assign_images_to_items(item_ids: List[int], n_images: int, seed: int = 42) -> Dict[int, str]:\n    \"\"\"Assign each item to a deterministic image filename.\"\"\"\n    random.seed(seed)\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n    \n    image_files = [f\"image_{i:05d}.jpg\" for i in range(n_images)]\n    # Deterministic assignment: item_id -> image_index\n    assignments = {}\n    for item_id in item_ids:\n        # Use hash-based deterministic assignment\n        img_idx = hash(str(item_id)) % len(image_files)\n        assignments[item_id] = image_files[img_idx]\n    \n    return assignments\n\n\ndef create_clusters_from_items(item_ids: List[int], n_clusters: int = 20, seed: int = 42) -> Dict[int, int]:\n    \"\"\"Assign each item to a cluster ID.\"\"\"\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n    \n    # Create cluster assignments with some locality\n    # Items that are close in ID space are more likely to be in same cluster\n    clusters = {}\n    \n    for item_id in item_ids:\n        # Base cluster on item_id with some noise\n        base_cluster = (item_id // (max(item_ids) // n_clusters + 1)) % n_clusters\n        # Add small random perturbation\n        noise = np.random.randint(-2, 3)\n        cluster_id = (base_cluster + noise) % n_clusters\n        clusters[item_id] = cluster_id\n    \n    return clusters\n\n\ndef generate_regime_dataset(\n    regime_name: str,\n    request_sequence: np.ndarray,\n    item_embeddings: Dict[int, np.ndarray],\n    item_to_image: Dict[int, str],\n request sequence, create a record\n    for item_id in tqdm(unique_item_ids, desc=f\"Processing {regime_name} items\"):\n        # Get item metadata\n        embedding = item_embeddings[item_id]\n (simplified)\n        first_occurrence = np.where(request_sequence == item_id)[0]\n        if len(first_occurrence) > 0:\n            timestamp = timestamp_offset + int(first_occurrence[0])\n        else:\n            timestamp = timestamp_offset\n        \n        item_record = {\n            \"item_id\": int(item_id),\n            \"timestamp\": timestamp,\n            \"embedding\": embedding.tolist(),  # 512-d embedding\n            \"image_file\": image_file,\n            \"cluster_id\": int(cluster_id),\n            \"popularity_count\": int(popularity),\n            \"metadata_fold\": \"train\"  # Will be split later\n        }\n        items.append(item_record)\n    \n    regime_data = {\n        \"request_sequence\": request_sequence.tolist(),  # Store the sequence once\n        \"items\": items\n    }\n    \n    return regime_data\n\n\ndef split_temporal_order(regime_data: Dict, train_ratio: float = 0.7, val_ratio: float = 0.15) -> Tuple[Dict, Dict, Dict]:\n    \"\"\"Split dataset by temporal order (no shuffling) based on item timestamps.\"\"\"\n    items = regime_data[\"items\"]\n    request_sequence = regime_data[\"request_sequence\"]\n    \n    # Sort items by timestamp\n    sorted_items = sorted(items, key=lambda x: x[\"timestamp\"])\n    \n    n_total = len(sorted_items)\n    n_train = int(n_total * train_ratio)\n    n_val = int(n_total * val_ratio)\n    \n    train_items = sorted_items[:n_train]\n    val_items = sorted_items[n_train:n_train + n_val]\n    test_items = sorted_items[n_train + n_val:]\n    \n    # Update metadata_fold\n    for item in train_items:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"train\"\n    for item in val_items:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"validation\"\n    for item in test_items:\n        item[\"metadata_fold\"] = \"test\"\n    \n    # Create the split regime data (each split gets the same request sequence)\n    train_data = {\n        \"request_sequence\": request_sequence,\n    # Create a shifted version where popularity changes midway\n    mid_point = len(request_sequence) // 2\n    shifted_sequence = request_sequence.copy()\n    \n    # For second half, boost some
